description: This file defines the Subscription class within the OpenCart admin mail controller namespace. It provides methods for handling subscription history updates via email notifications and processing subscription transactions, including database interactions, email task creation, and language management.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: A controller class managing email notifications for subscription history updates and transaction processing within the admin area of OpenCart.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Handles updates to subscription history by retrieving relevant subscription data, preparing email content, and scheduling email tasks for notifications.

methods.name: transaction
methods.description: Processes subscription transaction events, verifies order and subscription data, and queues email notifications about transaction updates.
